text: {"lessons":["My account has grown overall despite several down months, so I should stay focused on the longer term rather than react to each monthly change.","Selling portions of Stock B and Stock D after large gains reduced my exposure while keeping some shares invested; I should make such decisions according to a plan, not just past gains.","Because I check my account infrequently and rarely trade, a simple, deliberate approach is more suitable than trying to time short-term price moves."]}
